'''Clint Prong''' was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], listed as Gold 93 from Farmington, MI.<ref name="sm-fan" /> The slot was retired after Decipher's SWCCG run.

His younger brother introduced him to the game in 1996. [[Kendrick Summers]] selected him for Gold Squadron after a plug from [[Henry Vogel]].<ref name="decsq-prof" />

== In their own words ==

<blockquote>
I decided to apply for directorship so I could at least meet a few of the other players in this area. I thought I might be wasting my time when only 5 players showed up for my first tournament. However, I was averaging around 20 players per tournament.<ref name="decsq-prof" />
</blockquote>
